mapper.select: select REVIEW_ID, PRODUCT_ID, REVIEWER_NO, REVIEWEE_NO, RATING, CONTENT, to_char(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as "CREATED_AT_STR", R.CREATED_AT, U.NICKNAME as "REVIEWER_NICKNAME" from REVIEWS R join USERS U on R.REVIEWER_NO = U.USER_NO where REVIEWEE_NO = 1 order by CREATED_AT desc

select REVIEW_ID, PRODUCT_ID, REVIEWER_NO, REVIEWEE_NO, RATING, CONTENT, to_char(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as "CREATED_AT_STR", R.CREATED_AT, U.NICKNAME as "REVIEWEE_NICKNAME" from REVIEWS R join USERS U on R.REVIEWEE_NO = U.USER_NO where REVIEWER_NO = #{userNo} order by CREATED_AT desc
mapper.insert: insert into REVIEWS (PRODUCT_ID, REVIEWER_NO, REVIEWEE_NO, RATING, CONTENT) values (#{productId}, #{reviewerNo}, #{revieweeNo}, #{rating}, #{content})
